# CouchLoom

Multi-vault CouchDB/Obsidian LiveSync knowledge service for AI agents.

## Stable endpoints

- GET /health: process liveness
- GET /ready: JSON core readiness plus rag.enabled/state/coverage/backlog/failed.
  HTTP 200 includes RAG ready, backfilling, or degraded. HTTP 503 means the core
  vault/metadata service is unavailable.
- GET /metrics: unauthenticated private-network Prometheus metrics; never
  contains note paths, queries, tokens, or credentials
- POST /mcp: authenticated MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint

## MCP contract

Call list_vaults first. Pass vault_id to every note and search operation.
Available tools: list_vaults, list_folders, list_tags, list_notes, read_note,
get_note_metadata, search_notes, get_index_status, write_note, edit_note.
Deletion and moving are intentionally unavailable.

get_index_status returns per-vault metadata/RAG state: enabled, state, model,
expected, indexed, backlog, failed, coverage, oldestJobAgeSeconds,
lastSuccessAt, lastError, lastReconciliationAt, and checkpoint. Treat
backfilling as usable but incomplete; treat degraded as usable metadata plus an
operator action for RAG.

## Configuration

Prefer VAULTS_CONFIG_FILE pointing to a JSON array conforming to
docs/vaults.schema.json. RAG requires DATABASE_URL, EMBEDDING_BASE_URL,
EMBEDDING_MODEL, and EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS. MCP_AUTH_TOKEN enables bearer/OAuth
authentication.

Durable RAG defaults: RAG_RETRY_LIMIT=10, RAG_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS=1,
RAG_RETRY_DELAY_MAX_SECONDS=900, RAG_JOB_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS=30,
RAG_JOB_EXPIRE_SECONDS=300, RAG_QUEUE_SUPERVISE_INTERVAL_SECONDS=30,
RAG_DATABASE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS=5000, RAG_RECONCILE_INTERVAL_MS=300000,
RAG_WORKER_CONCURRENCY=1, and
RAG_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS=30000. The queue names are rag-index and
rag-index-dead-letter. A CouchDB checkpoint advances only after durable enqueue;
the worker rereads current source content; reconciliation repairs missing,
stale, model-mismatched, and orphaned rows.

VM100 invariant: EMBEDDING_BASE_URL is the private
http://couchloom-ollama:11434/v1 endpoint. Note content must not be sent to an
external embedding API. PostgreSQL and Ollama have no published host ports.

Metrics: couchloom_rag_documents_expected,
couchloom_rag_documents_indexed, couchloom_rag_coverage_ratio,
couchloom_rag_queue_jobs, couchloom_rag_oldest_job_age_seconds,
couchloom_rag_retries_total, couchloom_rag_failures_total,
couchloom_rag_reconciliation_duration_seconds,
couchloom_rag_embedding_duration_seconds,
couchloom_rag_search_duration_seconds, couchloom_couchdb_watcher_lag.

Initial alerts: terminal failed jobs > 0; oldest queued job >= 600 seconds;
coverage < 0.999 for 15 minutes after source changes; warm search p95 >= 0.3
seconds; cold search p95 >= 1 second. Detailed commands and recovery steps are
in docs/RAG_OPERATIONS.md.

Clone normally; this repository has no Git submodules. Generate a bearer token
with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Store the same secret as MCP_AUTH_TOKEN for
CouchLoom and COUCHLOOM_MCP_TOKEN for OpenClaw, outside Git in mode-0600
environment files. OpenClaw uses transport `streamable-http` at `/mcp`.

LiveSync compatibility source is owned in-tree at
packages/core/lib/livesync-commonlib, imported from upstream commit
50d4ab9c1a7d4f59ab29c7555b8dfb2d69555e92.
